description: Source of truth for Agent App API routes that a muxsh-family Node CLI binds to. Checked, on the Rust side, against the real struct's serde field names (test alongside each struct's own definition), and, on the Node side, against what muxsh actually sends (muxsh.contract.test.mjs). A route entry here is a claim: 'this is the real, current field set' — both tests fail if either side drifts from it. 'exactMatch: true' routes are checked as an exact field-name set in both directions (manifest == real struct fields); 'exactMatch: false' routes only list the subset of fields muxsh actually constructs — appropriate for a struct with many more optional fields muxsh never touches (documented per-route below), where full enumeration adds no real DRY protection for muxsh's own risk surface.

pane.list.note: Query param only (block_id or workspace_id), no request body — not a field-drift risk the same way a POST body is. No contract test; listed for documentation completeness.

agent.list.note: No request body (GET, no params). Response is a raw serde_json::Value built ad hoc in handle_discovery, not a typed struct — no Rust-side struct to contract-test against. Listed for documentation completeness.

agent.send.note: InjectionRequest has many more optional fields (source_agent, request_id, priority, wait_for_idle, jekt_tier, delivery_tier, forward_hops, ts_secs, jekt_sig, ...) that muxsh never sets — this entry lists only the two muxsh actually constructs. Subset-checked, not exact-matched.
